text.description_html:
Emtek BTB-86156, Tuscany Column Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair

The Column Lost Wax Bronze Back-to-Back Pull Set is part of Emtek's Tuscany Collection. It features the Earthly tones and metal construction that is so popular in Tuscan decor. The Tuscany Column Back-To-Back Door Handle Pair will fit doors 1-3/8 inches to 2-1/4 inches thick and comes packaged as a set of two pulls and mounting hardware. Choose from either flat black or medium bronze finishes.

Back-to-Back Mounting: Pulls bolt to each other through the door. Packaged with 2 door pulls (1 door pull for each side of a door).

Also Available: Column Pull with Thru-Bolt Mounting

Specifications of the Emtek Tuscany Column Lost Wax Cast Bronze Pull Set:

  • Material: Lost Wax Cast Bronze
  • Center to Center Length: 8" (c.c.)
  • Total Length: 11"
  • Pull Handle Width: 13/16"
  • Total Projection: 3"
  • Base: 1-1/4" square
  • Door Thickness: for doors 1-3/8" to 2-1/4" thick.
  • Includes installation hardware required for fiberglass, wood, and metal doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 Door Pulls) with Back-to-Back mounting.
